I still have no real figures, because the analysis role has not yet published any results. It has pushed its aggregation scripts, though, so I could see its actual table layout and adapt my generators to it.

- **Schema change:** the analysis role writes Parquet tables, not the CSVs I had assumed. They use short codes for estimators and designs. The no-interference column is a pseudo-mechanism named `"0"`. The degree I group by is the run's target degree. `figtab/common.py` now maps these to display names, and I updated the fixture and the data-contract note to match. Fig 1 (regime map) and Fig 3 (bias and SD) still run on the fixture, which writes only to `/tmp`.
- **Interval detail for the captions:** the analysis role's RMSE ratios to difference-in-means are natural-log ratios. Their paired bootstrap resamples graph draws only, not graph draws and then assignments as the plan says. When there is a single graph draw, as on the real graphs, it uses a delta-method interval instead. I'll say this in the captions and tell the analysis role about the mismatch if the final files show it too.

I'll build the rest of the figures and tables once the first results files exist. I pushed the adapted loaders to `main`.
